message.content: {"question":"A bullet with mass m = 50 g travels at a speed of v = 200m/s and embeds itself into the rim of a disk at rest that can rotate freely, at a distance of R = 60 cm from the center. The disk mass is M = 0.9 Kg. What is the angular speed of the system (M + m) after the collision?","options":{"A":"ω=33 s⁻¹","B":"ω=3.3 s⁻¹","C":"ω=0.3 s⁻¹","D":"ω=6.0 s⁻¹"},"correct":"A"}
